main_body: Roofed stone well: a snow-covered roof on two wooden posts, over a stone basin with a dark water opening and a brick-banded front face
top_band: Basin top is an ellipse: light grey back rim rows 16-17 (L=145-249), dark water interior rows 18-21, lighter front rim rows 22-23 (L=145). The snow roof above is a separate light band at rows 2-8.
evidence: In the x=15 column the light snow roof (rows 2-8) ends in an icicle edge at row 9. The basin then shows a light rim (row 16), a dark ellipse interior with a brown bucket (rows 17-22), and a front rim (row 23). Below that is the banded stone front face (rows 24-30), which reads as a vertical face. The opening is seen from above as an ellipse, and the roof and basin both show horizontal surfaces over front faces. No receding side faces. This matches the roofed-well reference.

style.evidence: The snow roof has about 5 tones (white, pale blue-white, light blue-grey, mid blue, dark blue) with ragged icicle edges. The stone and wood carry brown and blue-tinted dark outlines, and the measured neutral share of dark edge pixels is 0%. Flat-fill coverage is 0%. At 14 colours per tile and 24 distinct colours it is a little below the references (17 and 20 per tile, 38-40 distinct), but the stone bands, snow and posts are shaded comparably, so it would sit acceptably beside the reference well.
